browser.pointer: Playwright mobile emulation with hasTouch=true and isMobile=true; deviceScaleFactor=1.

scalePolicy: Each textScale snapshots all HTML computed font sizes before changing any ancestor/child styles, then multiplies HTML text and line height. Mermaid SVG root and SVG text/tspan styles remain fixed at rendered baseline.
layoutPolicy: Actual pinned Mermaid renderer and registered cose-bilkent plugin; no seed or positions injected. The basic tree is enhanced three times in one page to observe repeatability.

cases.description: Single root node using the default shape.
Default COSE-Bilkent tree with a root and branches at two depths.
The six explicit grammar shapes (square, rounded, circle, cloud, bang, hexagon), alongside a default node.
Long labels around the 200 CSS-pixel default maximum node width.
Valid nonuniform indentation; parents are determined by the nearest preceding shallower node.
A second top-level node has no parent and captures the pinned parser/render error.
